newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes mixed amid overhead resistance.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes mixed amid overhead resistance.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed mixed with attempts to rally the market again faltering on the awareness of substantial offers near the recent highs, traders said.
"The market is beginning to get significant overhead resistance in it," a trader said.
They said substantial supplies of low quality rice were available at low prices from Vietnamese stocks and the world benchmark Thai price was steady with a weak undertone.
Rice closed three cents per cwt higher to three lower, with January up three at $11.35 per cwt.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 350 contracts, below the 654 traded Friday.
